channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 14
item.description:
132 development commits

Performance & Economy

  • Optimized server upkeep calculations, reducing lag during upkeep recalculations.
  • Stopped deep‑sea tree‑spawn RPCs from being broadcast to all players, cutting unnecessary network traffic.

Dungeons & Events

  • Restored missing and incomplete maps in the Halloween and Christmas dungeons, fixing navigation and layout.
  • Fixed movement glitches where players could become stuck on holiday lights by applying proper physics material.
  • Resolved invisible or disconnected players blocking Halloween candy spawns.

Combat & Weapons

  • Adjusted the UZI 9mm’s magazine capacity and fire rate, and fixed related deployment and ADS issues.
  • Corrected turret aim inconsistencies and ensured turret viewmodels play the proper animations.
  • Monument blockers outside military tunnels now require explosives to break, matching other red‑card room blockers.

Audio & Sound

  • Fixed several sound issues: restored proper train audio, added missing ballista and catapult sounds, and corrected various other sound effects.

Gameplay & UI

  • Repaired the Frankenstein pet’s movement by adding its missing navigation component.
  • Fixed a pending‑item notice error when purchasing from marketplace terminals.
  • Resolved a non‑interactable bootstrap modal that could prevent players from proceeding.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 13
item.description:
96 development commits

Survival & Movement

  • Sprint now consumes double calories and fluids by default (server.sprintmetabolismscale = 2).

Combat & Weapons

  • Shotguns fully reload all chambers when switching ammo types.
  • UZI 9mm now has separate ADS and recoil settings depending on stock deployment.
  • Handmade SMG damage increased from 20 to 21.

Building & Utilities

  • Distance flares no longer stay permanently off.
  • Blocks placed with a building plan now receive proper network IDs.

Vehicles & Map

  • Car spawning pre‑fills more engine slots (5‑slot engines start with 3 slots filled).
  • Middle‑mouse button can now drag map markers to reposition them.

Tattoo Customization

  • Tattoo system upgraded: brush size limited to 1‑5, zoom‑independent scaling, UV smoothing, and a two‑layer editing workflow with merging and fading, all synced server‑side.

Combat & Mechanics

  • Rear turret crosshair no longer sticks, restoring proper aiming
  • Fixed far‑shot and shell replay bugs, improving long‑range shooting consistency

UI & Controls

  • Tooltip bindings now display correct keys, fixing mismatched prompts
  • Steam Input glyphs corrected and cached, ensuring accurate controller button icons

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 12
item.description:
139 development commits

Animal & Farming

  • Dung boost now applies continuously while an animal eats from the trough, and booster items are prioritized over other food.

Hardcore & Building Upkeep

  • Hardcore upkeep rates for bases larger than 65 blocks are increased (0.1/0.15/0.25/0.4), while smaller bases remain unchanged.
  • Triangle spiral stairs now include an upkeep component, affecting maintenance costs.

Seasonal Events & Items

  • Seasonal dungeons and Halloween NPCs no longer spawn inside player-built private areas or safezones, reducing unwanted encounters.
  • Event candy items (Halloween, Easter) are cleared on server restart, and food placed in the workbench recycle bin upgrade no longer spoils, preventing leftover loot waste.
  • Halloween DLC items are fixed: lights are craftable with correct stack size and cost, and the alien suit correctly blocks the torso.

Combat & Boats

  • Patrol torpedo boats now stay engaged with targets above sea level and hidden player ranking prioritizes visible players; boat privilege regression with cache usage is resolved.
  • First‑person laser weapons work correctly again, and explosives attached to solar panels now scale properly.

Input & Gamepad

  • Gamepad support expanded with missing type definitions, stick input is ignored when another device is active, and duck‑latching logic is isolated to gamepads, fixing stick‑drift and escape‑menu input issues.

Combat & Weapon Performance

  • First‑person weapon effects no longer spawn then hide, cutting a small delay and making AK fire feel snappier.
  • AK muzzle flash now appears instantly, fixing a previous lag caused by particle mesh lookups.
  • Inventory rebuild after each shot runs only when the inventory UI is open, reducing shooting‑related frame spikes.
  • Mag drop handling unified with the glass‑AK system, ensuring consistent drop behavior across weapons.

Stability

  • Server‑side key‑setting limits raised and a hard cap added, preventing crashes from exceeding Steam key quotas.

UI & Menu

  • Main menu rendering issue fixed, eliminating occasional blank screens when launching the game.
  • Death screen now correctly shows thrown weapons, fixing missing icons after a kill.

Animal Interaction

  • Sheep and cow interactions receive longer gestures, added foot‑stomp and head‑shake sounds, and better player‑facing behavior.
